fatigue.loading: Monotonic tension only (no cyclic loading in this dataset)
fatigue.crack_initiation: Not fatigue-tested, but companion analyses (Charpagne et al. 2021; Hestroffer et al. 2023) used this 3D volume + HR-DIC: >500 slip bands analysed; >50% emanate from triple junction lines and the most intense, longest bands lie near/parallel to specific annealing twin boundaries - argued to be the critical fatigue crack nucleation configurations in IN718.

notes: Best publicly available 3D EBSD + strain-field benchmark for twin/triple-junction slip localization in a Ni superalloy; FE meshes ready for CPFE/FIP studies. Dryad landing page did not show a license itself; CC BY 4.0 stated in the Sci. Data paper.
